## Findings

### spec-fidelity: Non-strict comparison in belowLimit
src/function.mjs:1 uses `value <= limit`, so `belowLimit(5, 5)` returns true. The spec chooses strict `value < limit` and the AC says equality is rejected. Change the comparison to `value < limit`.

### ac-coverage: Missing equality test for belowLimit
test/function.test.mjs tests only 4 and 6 against 5, so the equality AC has no test and the boundary defect above passes. Add `assert.equal(belowLimit(5,5), false)`.
